title: Fallen, Fallen is Babylon

questions.question: The oracle concerning the wilderness of the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 21:1 (ESV): "The oracle concerning the wilderness of the sea."

questions.question: For a stern vision is told to me; the traitor betrays, and the destroyer destroys. Go up, O Elam; lay siege, O what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 21:2 (ESV): "Go up, O Elam; lay siege, O Media;"

questions.question: My loins are filled with anguish; pangs have seized me, like the pangs of a woman in what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 21:3 (ESV): "like the pangs of a woman in labor;"

questions.question: Prepare the table, watch in the watchtower, eat, drink. Arise, O princes, oil the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 21:5 (ESV): "Arise, O princes, oil the shield!"

questions.question: One answering said: "Fallen, fallen is what?"
As whirlwinds in the Negeb sweep on, it comes from the wilderness, from a terrible what?
Go, set a watchman; let him announce what he what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 21:6 (ESV): "let him announce what he sees."

questions.question: When he sees riders, horsemen in pairs, riders on donkeys, riders on camels, let him listen diligently, very what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 21:7 (ESV): "let him listen diligently, very diligently."

questions.question: And all the carved images of her gods he has shattered to the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 21:9 (ESV): "he has shattered to the ground."

questions.question: O my threshed and winnowed one, what I have heard from the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, I announce to whom?
The oracle concerning Dumah. One is calling to me from Seir, "Watchman, what time of the what?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 21:11 (ESV): "Watchman, what time of the night?"

questions.question: The watchman says: "Morning comes, and also the night. If you will inquire, inquire; come back what?"
The oracle concerning Arabia. In the thickets in Arabia you will lodge, O caravans of whom?
Bring water to the thirsty, meet the fugitive with bread, O inhabitants of the land of whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 21:14 (ESV): "O inhabitants of the land of Tema,"

questions.question: For within a year, according to the years of a hired worker, all the glory of Kedar will come to an end. And the remainder of the archers of the mighty men of the sons of Kedar will be what?

key_verse_text: And behold, here come riders, horsemen in pairs! And he answered, "Fallen, fallen is Babylon; and all the carved images of her gods he has shattered to the ground."
